title: English Practice Quiz 0934
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Personal data is information that can identify ___.
questions.explanation: Personal data relates to an identifiable person.

questions.question: A secure screen lock helps prevent ___.
questions.explanation: A screen lock restricts access by unauthorised users.

questions.question: When sending a file containing personal data, you should use ___.
options: a public link with no restrictions
questions.explanation: Approved secure methods reduce the risk of unauthorised disclosure.

questions.question: Data minimisation means collecting ___.
options: only the information needed for a stated purpose
every detail that might be interesting
questions.explanation: Data minimisation limits collection to what is necessary.

questions.question: A data breach may involve ___.
options: unauthorised access, loss or disclosure of information
questions.explanation: A breach can compromise the confidentiality, integrity or availability of data.

questions.question: Before sharing someone's contact details, you should check ___.
options: whether you are authorised and have a valid reason
whether the file has a colourful name
questions.explanation: Contact details should be shared only when authorised and necessary.

questions.question: A strong privacy practice is to dispose of sensitive paper records by ___.
options: using the approved secure disposal method
leaving them in a public bin
giving them to an unknown visitor
questions.explanation: Secure disposal helps prevent information from being recovered or misused.

questions.question: A privacy notice explains how personal information is ___.
questions.explanation: A privacy notice describes relevant information-handling practices.

questions.question: If you receive personal information by mistake, you should ___.
options: avoid sharing it and report the incident as required
questions.explanation: Misdirected personal data should be handled under the organisation's incident procedure.

questions.question: Access to confidential records should follow the principle of ___.
questions.explanation: Least privilege limits access to what a person needs for their role.
